item_short_desc: Rothco's Mini Hammock is a compact and lightweight hammock that is perfect for anyone out in the field or camping. The mini hammock is constructed with a rugged poly mesh that can hold up to 300 LBS and measures 94"x42" with a telescoping spreader bar. The hammock which ways only 1 1/4 LBS also features a convenient mesh stuff sack. Rothco carries a large selection of outdoor and camping supplies.
